strategy.overview: Barnyard is a short timed target game built for the P3. The sun rises when play begins and sets when time expires. Balls are unlimited during that window, so keep shooting the on-screen animals and immediately continue after every drain.
strategy.simpleOverview: Shoot as many on-screen animals as possible before the sun sets. Balls are unlimited during the timed game, so launch the next ball immediately after every drain.
strategy.summary: Hit as many on-screen animals as possible from sunrise to sunset. Drains do not end the game: launch each replacement ball immediately and keep shooting until night falls.

quickInfo.name: Sunrise to sunset
quickInfo.summary: The complete game is one timed day. It ends when the on-screen sun goes down.

quickInfo.name: Unlimited balls
quickInfo.summary: A drain serves another ball while time remains, so there is no reason to wait before continuing.

quickInfo.name: Animals
quickInfo.summary: Aim through the animals shown on the lower display; each hit adds to the timed score.

steps.text: Launch as soon as the sun rises; the timer is the only limit on the complete game.
Aim physical shots through the animals visible on the lower display and keep moving to the next target.
After a drain, launch the replacement ball immediately because balls remain unlimited until sunset.
Continue hitting animals until the sun sets and the game records the final score.
Choose the most repeatable physical shot that crosses an available animal.
Minimize time between a drain and the next launch.
Keep shooting throughout the final daylight instead of protecting a ball that can be replaced.

cautions.issue: Barnyard works with every P3 upper module.
cautions.response: Aim by the animal's position on the lower display rather than memorizing one module-specific shot.
